title: Hakone add-on manifest (addon.json)
description: The package manifest of a Hakone add-on, format version 1. The host refuses unknown keys.
$comment: Host-only rules (Manifest::parse checks these; this schema does not): (1) The serialized manifest is at most 256 KiB. (2) api.addon and each api.contracts range must contain version 1.0.0. A range has at most 8 '||' clauses of at most 8 terms. (3) Each number in a semantic version fits in an unsigned 64-bit integer. (4) String limits count UTF-16 code units, not code points. (5) Each file path is in Unicode NFC, and no two paths are equal after case folding. (6) runtime.entry, settings.schema, settings.ui, each migration resource, each locale file, each nonempty contribution resource/view/theme/scene/icon, each asset path and the root icon must occur in files. (7) Contribution IDs are unique in the package. (8) completionPolicy: each feature occurs in the contribution's features, each operation occurs in its operations, and each feature/operation pair occurs once. (9) UI data schemas: each required name is a declared property; minimum <= maximum, minLength <= maxLength and minItems <= maxItems; at most 10 levels and 256 nodes; the initial state (or {}) agrees with stateSchema. (10) locales.files contains the locales.default key. (11) Each credential binding origin is a declared network.http origin (network.websocket for wss), and each field/origin/header triple (header case-insensitive) occurs once. (12) Origins and URLs must parse as strict URLs: port 1-65535, valid host syntax. (13) Settings and storage migrations: to = from + 1, to is not more than the declared version, and each from occurs once. (14) A ui.panel command names a ui.command of the same package that has a command operation and no route. (15) Manifest::validateContents (not part of parse) checks the package files: sizes, the settings schema document, account fields, account recipes and credential fields.

id.description: The package ID. The prefixes hakone.builtin and vlc.builtin are reserved for the host.

text.description: A nonempty string of at most 4096 characters, without NUL.

semanticVersion.description: A Semantic Versioning 2.0.0 version of at most 128 characters.

versionRange.description: A version range such as ">=1.0.0 <2.0.0" or "^1.0.0". The host must find 1.0.0 in the range.

portablePath.description: A relative package path that is portable to all supported file systems.

optionalResource.description: A package path from the file list. The host also accepts an empty string.

sourceUrl.description: An HTTPS repository URL without user data, query or fragment.

httpsOrigin.description: An HTTPS origin: no user data, path, query or fragment. A final "/" is permitted. Port 0 is not.

wssOrigin.description: A WSS origin in canonical form: lowercase, no port, no path and no final "/".

credentialBinding.description: The host puts the secret of a settings field into one header for one declared origin.

permissionSet.description: Permissions by capability name. Each capability has its own scope keys.

permissions.$comment: A capability cannot be both required and optional.

uiSchema.description: The UI data schema subset: one type per node, closed objects and typed enums.

completionPolicy.description: Completion rules for a metadata provider: an HTTP 404 or 410 answer means that the item is absent.

contribution.description: One feature that the package adds to the app.

placement.description: ui.panel only: the layout zone that the app uses one time for the panel's button, if the zone has space.

header.description: ui.panel only: the id of a Row in the panel's view that is its header. The app shows that row above the scrolled view, ends it with the close button, and drops its own title; the view runs edge to edge.
